name: emi-readback
title: EMI Readback
description: Reads back EMI, total interest, processing fee with GST, other upfront charges, the amount that reaches the account and the APR computed as in RBI's Key Facts Statement, catching tenure in the wrong unit, monthly rates typed as yearly, flat rates and heavy fees.

meta.stops: Signed for a loan costing more
meta.summary: Reads back a loan's EMI, total interest, fees and real yearly cost before signing, so a borrower doesn't agree to a costlier loan than they think.
catches: Tenure typed in months when years were meant, or the reverse
A monthly rate typed as yearly
Flat rates that hide a much higher reducing rate
Fees and GST that cut what actually reaches the account
limits: A reducing-balance estimate; lenders' day counts and rounding differ slightly
GST on the processing fee defaults to 18%
Not financial advice; the lender's KFS is the binding document
a11y: Each term has a <label>, aria-invalid and aria-describedby to its issues
Focus moves to the first fix

sources.label: RBI circular: Key Facts Statement (KFS) for Loans & Advances (15 Apr 2024)

rules.note: Informational; check the official source. Checked that APR must include all charges levied by the lender. The Annex B worked example (17.07%) was not re-checked: the annex PDF could not be fetched. GST rate on fees not checked.
